packageRules.description: Next, React and the Next ESLint preset move together
TypeScript 7 (@typescript/native, runs tsc) and the TypeScript 6 API package (typescript) move together; see P11.23 in the Phase 11 plan
ESLint and its plugins move together. Drop the eslint overrides in package.json once eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-import and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y list ESLint 10
Bump the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright tags in the workflows in the same pull request, then regenerate the visual baselines
bullmq pins its own ioredis; a second copy breaks the typecheck, so ioredis moves only when bullmq's pin does
The image runs Node 24 LTS, as CI does; a Node major moves both together by hand
